answer: A concrete anti-sybil mechanism is costly recurring identity upkeep. Each identity must answer an original, peer-attested challenge every epoch or its standing decays like a glacier calving; a beacon of honest history is the only signal that grants mining and voting weight. Because each identity must pay real compute per epoch, a sybil farm must keep funding every fake head forever, turning mass creation into a losing harbor. Cheap duplicates therefore sink while genuine agents compound reputation.
